text:
Iris Nakamoto: TL;DR postmortem: recurring KV eviction chains during bursty agent traffic caused cascading fallbacks and visible latency spikes. We need owners + short tests to prevent recurrence. Can we break this into concrete pieces for the next 10 working days?

Ben Wallace: Proposed minimal set: 1) replay-regression job (replay captured traces across scale windows), 2) eval promptset that reproduces long-prefix eviction, 3) a small load harness for token-rate bursts, 4) a one-off chaos run on staging to validate fallback behavior.

Rhea Kapoor: I can own the promptset + eval harness. Will create ~25 cases focusing on streaming boundaries and long-prefix churn. Expectation: fallback_rate < 0.5%. PR target: 2025-08-08.

Omar Singh: I'll take the replay runner and nightly CI job. Plan: reuse traces from /traces/incidents/eviction-2025-07 and preserve inter-request timing. Nightly for 14 days, fail-fast on fallback_rate > 1%. Local dev command: `./tools/replay --trace traces/eviction-2025-07.json --speed 1x`. CI job name: ci/jobs/eviction_replay.yml.

Ben Wallace: Load harness: small synthetic burst that sends token-heavy requests at controlled qps, scheduled nightly for 2 weeks then move to weekly. Targets: p50 < 140ms, p95 < 400ms, eviction_rate < 2%. I'll drop a small script in tests/load/eviction_burst.py.

Iris Nakamoto: Ownership recap: Rhea -> promptset + eval PR (due 8th Aug), Omar -> replay runner + CI (setup by 4th Aug), Ben -> load harness + CI (setup by 4th Aug), Iris -> coordinate chaos run + playbook (draft by 6th Aug). ops-bot, please create a follow-up ticket and schedule a 25m sync.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-5991 "eviction-cascade: regression, promptset, load, chaos" assigned to Iris Nakamoto, due 2025-08-20. Sync scheduled: 2025-08-05 11:00 UTC.

Rhea Kapoor: Promptset notes: include short/long pairs, streaming chunk boundary cases, and a negative set that forces variant selection. Example snippet in PR:```yaml
- id: evict_01
  input: "A" * 6000
  mode: streaming
  expect_contains: "continuation"
  assert_variant: not tiny
```

I'll include a lightweight mock so CI doesn't need full infra.

Omar Singh: Replay detail: preserve timestamps but allow `--compress 4x` for CI speed. Add a jitter flag to avoid being too deterministic. Add dashboard rows: nightly_replay/pass_rate, fallback_rate, eviction_rate. Failure routing: post to #eng-oncall after 2 consecutive fails.

Ben Wallace: I'll add dashboards for the load harness too and wire an alert if eviction_rate spikes > 3% during runs.

Iris Nakamoto: Chaos run plan: one-time on staging after 3 consecutive green nights. Simulate 30s of reduced GPU memory and watch model selection and fallback metrics. Jordan from infra to assist with the k8s job. Playbook snippet:```bash
kubectl apply -f tools/chaos/gpu_mem_throttle.yaml
sleep 30
kubectl delete -f tools/chaos/gpu_mem_throttle.yaml
```

Ben Wallace: Also recommend adding a gating rule for model swaps: require 7-night rolling green for eviction-related regressions. We can put this in the console docs.

Rhea Kapoor: Quick test expectation: `assert fallback_rate < 0.005 or p95_delta < 0.1` in eval harness to catch semantic regressions. Will document rationale in PR.

Omar Singh: I'll create CI job `ci/jobs/eviction_replay.yml` and hook traces. Also will add a short repro script in the repo so engineers can run the replay locally. PR will be up by EOD Fri.

ops-bot: Linked dashboards and added runbook snippet to INC-5991.

Iris Nakamoto: Timeline recap: Omar + Ben CI jobs by 2025-08-04, Rhea PR by 2025-08-08, playbook draft by 2025-08-06, chaos run after 3-night green window. If anyone needs to reprioritize call it out here.

Jordan (infra): happy to assist with chaos job. Will coordinate Slack/meeting once playbook is ready.

Ben Wallace: One more: post-run notify to #product when daily replay fails so product owners are aware before swaps.

Rhea Kapoor: Opening draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/901 (promptset + mock eval harness).

Omar Singh: Draft replay PR coming shortly.

Iris Nakamoto: Thanks all. We'll check progress in the scheduled sync. Marking INC-5991 in-progress. :thumbsup:
